ShaderNodePreset.Description: Shadow density and saturation control. Uses a smooth luminance mask to isolate the shadow zone (full effect at black, fading to zero at the pivot). Shadow Lift pulls down luminance; Shadow Desat reduces saturation toward neutral grey. Both effects share the same mask so lift and desat are always spatially consistent. Supports Rec.709, Scene-Linear, ACEScg, ACEScct, and ARRI LogC4.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_ShadowDensity

Uniform.Tooltip: Input color space. Sets luminance coefficients and whether a perceptual working space conversion is applied before operations. Match to your Flame project's color science.
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Pull down shadow luminance. 0 = off, -1 = maximum density.
Uniform.Name: shadowLift

Uniform.Tooltip: Luminance level above which the effect has no influence. Pixels at or above this threshold are completely unaffected.
Uniform.Name: shadowPivot

Uniform.Tooltip: Desaturation strength within the shadow zone. 0 = no desat, 1 = fully neutral grey in shadows. Uses the same luminance mask as Shadow Lift.
Uniform.Name: shadowDesatAmount
